facts.fact: The Internet Society says it granted funds in 2023 to the Benin Internet Exchange Point (BeninIX), which improved its technical infrastructure and held community events and capacity workshops.
The Internet Society says it granted funds in 2023 to an IXP in Malawi, where the ISP association MISPA will install a second IXP at Lilongwe (LLIX) for the central region.

MWI.note: Second IXP at Lilongwe is planned, not in service.

facts.fact: The Internet Society says RICTA ran a training in 2023 on using the RINEX infrastructure, which it describes as central to the daily operations and services RICTA provides.
